sub_service: Sewer connection application, blockage/overflow of sewer or drain, repair of damaged sewer/drainage lines
problem_type: Sewer/drain blockage, overflowing sewer or drain, damaged sewer line, new sewer connection request
authority: Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Sewerage) of the relevant zone
description: JMC's published Citizen Charter table for Sewerage/Drainage covers sewer connection application through to acceptance, fee payment, and repair, plus fault complaints (blockage, overflow, damaged line) -- each with its own minimum and maximum time-to-action.
procedure: Report to the Sub-Inspector (SI) or Junior Engineer for the relevant zone at the Zone Office on any working day; escalates to Assistant Engineer (Sewerage), then the Zonal Commissioner if unresolved.
sla: Sewer connection: application acceptance same day, acknowledgement within 1 day. Blockage of sewer/drainage: 3 hours (min) to same day (max). Over flowing of sewer/drain: 3 hours to same day. Repair of damaged sewer line: 3 hours (min) to 3 days (max).
expected_resolution_time: Same day for blockage/overflow; up to 3 days for damaged sewer line repair

sub_service: Pothole filling, patch repairs, removal of road obstruction, missing manhole cover replacement, debris removal, road-cut permission
problem_type: Potholes, damaged road surface, obstruction on road, missing manhole cover, debris on public land
authority: Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer of the relevant zone
description: JMC's Citizen Charter table for Roads/Street Maintenance lists 7 distinct activities, each with its own min/max time-to-action, from immediate safety issues (obstruction removal, missing manhole covers) to multi-day work (patch repairs, debris removal by the Corporation).
procedure: Report to the Junior Engineer/Assistant Engineer of the relevant zone at the Zone Office, any working day; escalates to Executive Engineer (Ex.En.), then the Zonal Commissioner.
sla: Filling of potholes: 1-3 days. Patch repairs: 3-7 days. Removal of obstruction on roads: 3 hours-1 day. Replacement of missing manhole covers: 3 hours-1 day. Removal of debris from public land by owner: 1 day. Removal of debris by Corporation (if owner fails to comply): 2-3 days. Decision on road-cut permission: 1-3 days.
expected_response_time: 3 hours for obstruction/missing manhole cover complaints
expected_resolution_time: 1-3 days for potholes; 3-7 days for patch repairs
